_comment: Public-domain check per author (BRIEF_V2 §7, DECISIONS D-276). Japan's term is life+70 since 2018-12-30; authors who died in 1967 or earlier were already public domain under the old life+50 rule, so died < 1968 is the test. `died` is the Aozora catalogue's 没年月日 and is re-checked against the pinned catalogue on every build, together with 作品著作権フラグ = なし for the work and 人物著作権フラグ = なし for every person on it.
